newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo April consumer prices up 1.2 pct year/year.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo April consumer prices up 1.2 pct year/year.

text.p: Tokyo area consumer prices rose 1.2 percent in April from a year earlier, while nationwide consumer prices for March increased 0.5 percent year-on-year, the government's Management and Coordination Agency said on Friday.
The rise followed an increase in Japan's sales tax to five from three percent on April 1.
Figures released for nationwide prices in the 1996/97 fiscal year, which ended March 31, showed a 0.4 percent rise from the previous year.
